prompt: Compare average monthly revenue between store regions for 2022 and 2023. Then show a grouped bar chart comparing average monthly revenue per region between 2022 and 2023

data.sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        st.region AS region,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) AS year,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.Sold_Date) AS month,
        SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM sales s
    JOIN stores st
        ON s.Store_Number = st.Store_Number
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) IN (2022, 2023)
    GROUP BY
        st.region,
        year,
        month
),
avg_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        mr.region,
        mr.year,
        AVG(mr.monthly_revenue) AS avg_monthly_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue mr
    GROUP BY
        mr.region,
        mr.year
)
SELECT
    a.region,
    a.year,
    ROUND(a.avg_monthly_revenue, 2) AS avg_monthly_revenue
FROM avg_monthly a
ORDER BY
    a.region,
    a.year;

data.analysis: For 2022 vs 2023, average monthly revenue increased in all regions: Midwest $63,132.53 → $64,928.65, Northeast $57,536.45 → $59,880.43, South $149,253.88 → $156,721.11, and West $171,382.24 → $169,813.07 (a slight decrease in West). Overall, the highest average monthly revenue is in the West for both 2022 ($171,382.24) and 2023 ($169,813.07), while the lowest is the Northeast for both years ($57,536.45 and $59,880.43).

prompt: Show 2023 revenue by region comparing Organic and Non-Organic products as a grouped bar chart. Then visualize a Grouped bar chart comparing 2023 revenue by region for organic and non-organic products

data.sql:
WITH sales_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    st.region AS region,
    p.is_organic AS is_organic,
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS revenue_2023
  FROM sales s
  JOIN stores st
    ON s.Store_Number = st.Store_Number
  JOIN products p
    ON s.SKU_Coded = p.SKU_Coded
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023
  GROUP BY
    st.region,
    p.is_organic
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_organic THEN revenue_2023 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS organic_revenue_2023,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_organic THEN revenue_2023 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS non_organic_revenue_2023
  FROM sales_2023
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
  p.region,
  p.organic_revenue_2023,
  p.non_organic_revenue_2023
FROM pivoted p
ORDER BY (p.organic_revenue_2023 + p.non_organic_revenue_2023) DESC;

prompt: Show promo revenue share by product category for 2023 as a bar chart, expressing the share as a percentage of total revenue. Then show a Bar chart showing the share of revenue generated under promotion for each product category in 2023

data.sql:
WITH cat_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.category AS product_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.On_Promo = 1 THEN s.Total_Sale_Value ELSE 0 END) AS promo_revenue,
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS total_revenue
  FROM sales s
  JOIN products p
    ON s.SKU_Coded = p.SKU_Coded
   AND s.Product_Class_Code = p.Product_Class_Code
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023
  GROUP BY p.category
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS grand_total_revenue
  FROM cat_totals
)
SELECT
  ct.product_category,
  ct.total_revenue,
  ct.promo_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN gt.grand_total_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * ct.total_revenue / gt.grand_total_revenue
  END AS total_revenue_share_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN ct.total_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * ct.promo_revenue / ct.total_revenue
  END AS promo_revenue_share_pct_of_category
FROM cat_totals ct
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
ORDER BY ct.total_revenue DESC;

prompt: Return the top 10 region-category combinations by year-over-year revenue growth from 2022 to 2023, showing revenue for both years and the growth expressed as a percentage rounded to 2 decimal places

data.sql:
WITH revenue_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    st.region AS region,
    p.category AS category,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) AS year,
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS revenue_usd
  FROM sales s
  JOIN stores st
    ON s.Store_Number = st.Store_Number
  JOIN products p
    ON s.SKU_Coded = p.SKU_Coded
   AND s.Product_Class_Code = p.Product_Class_Code
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) IN (2022, 2023)
  GROUP BY
    st.region,
    p.category,
    year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    rby.region,
    rby.category,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rby.year = 2022 THEN rby.revenue_usd END) AS revenue_2022_usd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rby.year = 2023 THEN rby.revenue_usd END) AS revenue_2023_usd
  FROM revenue_by_year rby
  GROUP BY
    rby.region,
    rby.category
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pv.region,
    pv.category,
    pv.revenue_2022_usd,
    pv.revenue_2023_usd,
    CASE
      WHEN pv.revenue_2022_usd IS NULL OR pv.revenue_2022_usd = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ((pv.revenue_2023_usd - pv.revenue_2022_usd) / pv.revenue_2022_usd) * 100
    END AS yoy_growth_pct
  FROM pivoted pv
)
SELECT
  rk.region,
  rk.category,
  rk.revenue_2022_usd AS revenue_2022_usd,
  rk.revenue_2023_usd AS revenue_2023_usd,
  ROUND(rk.yoy_growth_pct, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM ranked rk
WHERE rk.yoy_growth_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rk.yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
